rarityTiers.description: Most common eggs, drop frequently from building activity
Uncommon eggs with distinct patterns and materials
Royal eggs — diamond, gold, silver. Extremely rare drops

dropMechanism.description: Easter Eggs drop from building activity during the spring/Easter event. Drop rate is percentage per hour of building activity, scaled by spring market building levels.
dropMechanism.source: entry.js — EggCollection.easterEggsDropRate i18n string: 'Easter Eggs drop rate: {rate}% per hour of building activity ({levels} spring market levels)'

collecting.description: Collect eggs from a busy building. Returns eggs array.

collection.description: Get company's egg collection. Returns { eggs, timestamp }.

minting.description: Mint a unique Easter Egg collectible using one egg of each kind. Requires full collection. Action cannot be undone.
minting.i18n: EggCollection.mintCollectibleDescription: 'One egg of each kind will be used to create a unique Easter Egg collectible. This action cannot be undone.'

eggMovements.description: Get history of egg movements (drops, swaps, sales). Returns { movements, timestamp }.

eggSwappingMechanics.description: Swap one egg for another of the SAME rarity tier with other players.
eggSwappingMechanics.i18n: EggCollection.swapOneEggSameRarity: 'Swap one egg for another of the same rarity.'

listSwaps.description: Get all swap proposals for a company. Returns { swaps, timestamp }.

proposeSwap.description: Propose an egg swap with another company. Fields: receiverCompanyId, senderEggKind (your egg), receiverEggKind (their egg). Only same-rarity swaps are allowed.

getSwap.description: Get details of a specific swap

eggDealerMechanics.description: Sell eggs to the Easter Egg Dealer. Eggs are sold in order received. Price varies by supply. Unsold eggs are destroyed at end of event.

i18n.sellWarning: EggCollection.sellPriceNotGuaranteed: 'The sell price is not guaranteed'
i18n.unsoldWarning: EggCollection.unsoldEggsWarning: 'Unsold eggs cannot be retrieved back and the dealer will destroy them at the end of the event.'

nftCollectibleTrading.description: Collectibles are NFT-like unique assets that can be traded on the collectible exchange using SimBoosts.

collectibleDataShape.source: From chunk_oea.js NFT detail view and chunk_cji.js market list

listMarket.description: Get all collectibles listed on the market exchange

listForSale.description: List your collectible for sale on the exchange for SimBoosts

buyOrDelist.description: Purchase a collectible (costs SimBoosts) or delist your own. If you are the current owner, delisting is free.

simboostsAvailable.description: Get SimBoosts available for purchase by non-supporters

getAsset.description: Get NFT asset metadata. Append ?ipfs=true to include IPFS metadata (description, etc.)

getTrades.description: Get trade history for an NFT asset. Returns { trades: [{id, datetime, priceSimboosts}] }.

nftCollectibleTrading.costDriver: Wo.COLLECTIBLE_TRADE — purchasing collectibles is a SimBoost spend action

displayCaseMechanics.description: Showcase items on your company profile. Display case slots are unlocked with SimBoosts. Items that can be displayed: certificates, achievements, production resources, and collectibles (NFTs).

addItem.description: Add an item to the display case. One and only one item type ID must be provided.

unlockSlot.description: Unlock an additional display case slot. Costs SimBoosts. Returns { message, simBoosts: remaining }.

getRemoveItem.description: Get or remove a specific display case item

componentStateFields.displayCase: undefined | array — current display case items

ui.unlockSlotsLabel: Checkout.unlockDisplayCaseSlots: 'Unlock {slots} display case slots, where you can showcase your certificates, inventory, and achievements'

giftBasketCollectibles.description: Gift baskets can be upgraded to collectibles. Creating a gift basket collectible destroys an existing collectible and requires higher quality resource inputs.
keyMechanics: A collectible must be selected and destroyed to create the gift basket collectible
Higher quality resource inputs needed based on collectible quality
The receiver's company name and message are recorded in the collectible IPFS description
Collectible baskets are delivered last (after all normal deliveries)
No refund of resources, SimBoosts, collectible, or money on cancel
Gift cards cannot be made into collectibles — upgrade to basket required

i18n.noteQuality: giftBaskets.noteCreateCollectibleBasket: 'Note: Collectible basket creation requires higher quality of resource inputs - based on the collectible quality.'
i18n.elevateText: giftBaskets.thisWillTrulyElevate: 'This will truly elevate your gift to the next level. The receiver will get a gift basket collectible, ensuring lasting value outside the season. They will be able to put it on display, and/or trade with it. Your company and message will be recorded in the collectible description.'

collectibleEncyclopedia.description: The Encyclopedia provides a searchable catalog of collectibles and their collectors.

i18n.title: Encyclopedia.collectibles: 'Collectibles'
i18n.guideLink: Encyclopedia.readAboutCollectibleItems: 'Learn all about collectible items in the {guide}.'
i18n.phaseWarning: Encyclopedia.collectiblesNotAvailableInCurrentRealmPhase: 'Collectibles are not yet available in the current realm phase'

existingResourceQualityApi.description: Check existing resource quality for encyclopedia

collectibleIcons.description: Light = FontAwesome Light (outline), Solid = FontAwesome Solid, both using the 'gem' icon

sourceFiles.chunk_CBt.js: NFT collectors API wrapper + encyclopedia resource quality API
sourceFiles.chunk_Fle.js: Collectible render component (sS class) — displays collectible image with optional onClick
sourceFiles.chunk_$Ri.js: Realm collectibles display component — shows realm's collectible list

sourceFiles.chunk_oea.js: NFT asset detail view, egg swap list UI, minting UI
sourceFiles.chunk_uei.js: Display case collectible add modal, market list action modal
sourceFiles.entry.js: Egg type constants (Py), i18n strings, transaction types, collectible resource definitions
